text: The univalence axiom implies function extensionality. The proof goes via:
choices: using ua to build a path in (A→B) from a homotopy
explanation: Funext from UA: given h:f~g (a homotopy), define a path in (A→B) by transporting along ua(id) or by using the universal property of ua applied to a family. (Details are subtle but this is the main idea.)
